newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks seen steady on Wall Street rally.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks seen steady on Wall Street rally.

text.p: Jakarta stocks are seen steady on Wednesday on expected improved foreign participation following the overnight rise on Wall Street, but any possible upside is seen limited on political worries, brokers said.
"Foreign players have been rather slow in the past few days. We expect the Dow's rise to boost sentiment and prompt them to hunt for bargains, particularly in Telkom," one broker said.
On Tuesday, the Dow Jones industrial average posted its second biggest one-day gain ever as it ended up 135.26 points, or 2.10 percent, at 6,587.16.
Telkom shares in New York rose 3/8 to $30-1/8.
Brokers said any possible sharp upside was likely to be limited due to lingering uncertainties over the political situation ahead of the general election in late May.

Stocks which were likely to attract attention included conglomerate Bimantara on a rise in 1996 dividend payment and retailer Matahari after large trading of its shares on the cross board, brokers said.
Property firm Jababeka was the most actively traded as it rose 25 rupiah to 2,900 rupiah on expected strong revenues this year, one broker said.
